::: {#exm-contrapositive-not-converse}
#### A proposition and its contrapositive

Take "if today is Saturday, then today is a weekend day", which is true.

Its contrapositive is "if today is not a weekend day, then today is not Saturday".
It is also true, as @thm-contrapositive says it must be:
Monday through Friday are the days that are not weekend days, and none of them is Saturday.

:::
